name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv sync --frozen; uv run playwright install --with-deps chromium; echo '✅ Dependências (uv) e Chromium instalados'
